tasks.name: VisuospatialReasoning
tasks.description: Reason with visuospatial knowledge by retrieving visuospatial content, encoding it, and producing a consistent solution.

tasks.name: RetrieveVisuoSpatialContent
tasks.description: Retrieve visuospatial content required for reasoning by collecting visual and spatial components and assembling them.
tasks.makes: rawVisuoSpatialContent containing visual and spatial parts

tasks.name: EncodeVisuoSpatialContentAndSolve
tasks.description: Encode retrieved visuospatial content into a usable internal form by selecting an appropriate representation mode and solving using that mode.

tasks.name: SolveUsingPropositionalRepresentation
tasks.description: Construct a propositional representation of the visuospatial content, derive a causal pattern, and apply that causal pattern to produce a solution.

tasks.name: SolveUsingAnalogicalRepresentation
tasks.description: Solve a visuospatial problem using analogical structures: construct an analogical representation, map it onto the target problem, and produce a solution.

tasks.name: SystemThinking
tasks.description: Construct a Structure-Behavior-Function (SBF) model for a system by modeling visible structure, invisible behavior/function, and their multilevel interaction.

tasks.name: RepresentInvisibleBehaviorAndFunction
tasks.description: Infer and align the invisible behavior and function of a system with its structure.
tasks.makes: FunctionModel != null && BehaviorModel != null && SBF models aligned

tasks.name: DesignThinking
tasks.description: Perform design thinking: analyze the system using systems thinking, generate a creative design that satisfies the goal under constraints, and learn from that design.
tasks.given: DesignGoal != null && CurrentSystemModel != null && Constraints != null

tasks.name: GenerateCreativeDesign
tasks.description: Generate a new design for the goal by retrieving or replicating prior design patterns and transforming them to satisfy new constraints.
tasks.given: SystemInsights != null && Constraints != null && DesignGoal != null

tasks.name: SolveDunckerRadiationWithVisuospatialReasoning
tasks.description: Solve the Duncker radiation problem (doctor and tumor) by transferring the visuospatial structure of the fortress/army story. The goal is to propose a treatment plan that converges multiple weaker beams on the tumor from different directions.
tasks.given: fortressScene encodes central target with multiple approach paths AND medicalScene encodes tumor and body layout
tasks.makes: treatmentPlan decomposes a single damaging beam into multiple weak beams arriving simultaneously from multiple directions

tasks.name: ExplainPistonCrankSystemVisuospatially
tasks.description: Interpret the piston–cylinder and crankshaft engineering diagram as visuospatial knowledge to explain how linear piston motion becomes rotational crank motion.
tasks.given: mechanicalDiagram shows piston, rod, and crank geometry and linkages
tasks.makes: mechanismExplanation maps linear translation in the piston to rotational motion in the crank via mapped correspondences of connected parts

tasks.name: SolveRavensWithVisuospatialReasoning
tasks.description: Solve a Raven's Progressive Matrices item by representing panels as visuospatial structures and mapping structural transformations rather than relying purely on propositional symbolic rules.
tasks.given: matrixPanels encode shapes and spatial transforms across rows/columns
tasks.makes: chosenAnswer matches the panel whose structure best satisfies the discovered visuospatial transformation pattern

tasks.name: ModelFlashlightWithSBF
tasks.description: Produce an SBF model for a basic flashlight: identify visible structure (battery, switch, bulb), the invisible behavior (current flows when switch is pressed), and the function (produce light).
tasks.makes: flashlightSBF links structure (battery/switch/bulb) to behavior (current flow) to function (emit light)

tasks.name: Design20LumenFlashlight
tasks.description: Design a flashlight circuit that produces 20 lumens by using design thinking: reason about the current flashlight's SBF model, identify functional gap (10 → 20 lumens), and produce a higher-output design (e.g., higher voltage using two batteries in series).
tasks.given: DesignGoal specifies brightness increase beyond current output and CurrentSystemModel encodes the 10-lumen circuit
tasks.makes: ProposedDesign increases available voltage or cascades behavior to meet lumenTarget under resourceLimits

tasks.name: FailureGoal
tasks.description: Represents a failure state in the task execution.

tasks.name: SuccessGoal
tasks.description: Represents a success state in the task execution.
